one_sentence: Sax & Eddelbuettel (2018), 'Seasonal Adjustment by X-13ARIMA-SEATS in R', JSS 87(11):1-17, doi:10.18637/jss.v087.i11 -- entry's facts (authors, volume, pages, year) are correct but the title is unprotected/lowercased and the issue number and DOI are missing.

issues.original: Seasonal adjustment by x-13arima-seats in r
issues.reason: JSS title-cases article titles; the entry has it fully lowercased (not just unprotected). Correct rendering is 'Seasonal Adjustment by X-13ARIMA-SEATS in R'. Additionally, 'X-13ARIMA-SEATS' (the Census Bureau software) and the standalone 'R' must be brace-protected or a lowercase/sentence-case BibTeX style (e.g. apalike, chicago author-date) will mangle them to 'x-13arima-seats' and 'r'.

JSS articles each occupy their own issue number within a volume; volume 87 alone is insufficient to locate the article. The JSS landing page confirms Volume 87, Issue 11, Article 11 (article number equals issue number for this journal).
DOI omitted; verified on the JSS article landing page and resolves via https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v087.i11.
